rules.description: C# must be a thin interface only. WebGL delegates encryption to viverse-sdk GameDashboard. Editor implements RSA/AES via .NET crypto.

WebGL uses jslib + viverse-sdk GameDashboard for SubmitScore (handles encryption internally). Editor uses UnityWebRequest + RSACryptoServiceProvider + AES. Both paths in LeaderboardClient.cs selected via #if UNITY_WEBGL && !UNITY_EDITOR.
SubmitScore and GetLeaderboard require a valid access token. GetGuestLeaderboard does NOT require auth.
Use AccessToken header for JWT tokens, AuthKey header for non-JWT. Detect via split('.').length == 3.
metaName must match exactly what is configured in VIVERSE Studio. Case-sensitive. Leaderboard must exist server-side before use.
viveport.com does NOT allow CORS for localhost. WebGL jslib uses relative URLs (baseUrl: '/') and requires serve_webgl.sh proxy for local testing. Production on viverse.com works directly.
WebGL SubmitScore MUST use viverse-sdk GameDashboard.uploadLeaderboardScore() which bundles jsencrypt. Do NOT implement Web Crypto RSA in jslib — browsers don't support PKCS1v1.5 decrypt.

RSA/AES Ironhide encryption flow is Editor-only. Steps: generate RSA 2048 → export X509 DER public key → GET Ironhide token → decrypt symmetric key with RSA PKCS1 → encrypt scores with AES-CBC → POST.
LeaderboardClient is standalone REST. Never require MultiplayerClient or data channel connection.
